title: heracleum sphondylium var. latifolium
intro: Heracleum sphondylium var. latifolium, commonly known as garden angelica or broad-leaved angelica, is a biennial plant in the carrot family native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which helps to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of garden angelica include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Heracleum sphondylium var. latifolium include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
